title: A Workflow-Aware Serving Layer for Agentic Applications
authors: Jiayi Qian; Zishen Wan; Hanchen Yang; Chun Tao; Souvik Kundu; Tushar Krishna
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology, Columbia University, Intel
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Routing / Load balancing, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Agent orchestrators know workflow structure but not live backend load, while model-serving engines see load but not workflow-wide model, verifier, and quality choices; no layer owns the remaining physical plan as conditions change.
problem_statement.zh: agent orchestrator 掌握 workflow 結構但不知即時 backend load；model-serving engine 掌握負載卻不知 workflow 全域的 model、verifier 與品質選擇，因此在條件變動時無層級持續管理剩餘 physical plan。

key_innovation.en: Dyserve compiles per-node model, verifier, and backend choices jointly with an admission-time ILP, pre-solves pressure-rung strategies, switches only the uncommitted suffix from live telemetry, and performs one residual re-solve after a tool failure.
key_innovation.zh: Dyserve 以 admission-time ILP 聯合編譯每個 node 的 model、verifier 與 backend 選擇，預先求解多個 pressure-rung strategy，依即時 telemetry 僅切換未提交 suffix，並在工具失敗後進行一次 residual re-solve。

baselines_compared: Base routing, Verify-all, Sherlock-style placement, Admission-only compiled plan

key_improvements.en: Highest accuracy on all four workloads, 3-10 points above the highest-accuracy baseline at 1.1-6.8x lower latency; burst ladder raises SLO goodput from 25.7% to 67.2% in the headline (2+2) fleet.
key_improvements.zh: 四個 workload 皆達最高 accuracy，相較最高 accuracy baseline 提升 3–10 個百分點且 latency 降低 1.1–6.8x；headline (2+2) fleet 中，burst ladder 將 SLO goodput 由 25.7% 提升至 67.2%。

structural_input: Declared static DAG, Infra feedback to orchestrator

workloads_traces.en: LiveCodeBench (55), GAIA (35), ComplexFuncBench (100), and SWE-bench (40); steady equal-mass LCB/GAIA/CFB mixtures and multi-tenant burst traces.
workloads_traces.zh: LiveCodeBench（55）、GAIA（35）、ComplexFuncBench（100）與 SWE-bench（40）；另含 steady equal-mass LCB/GAIA/CFB mixture 與 multi-tenant burst traces。

key_parameters.en: Four-GPU single-node H200 fleets; up to 11 DAG nodes, 3 models x 8 verification policies, fewer than 270 joint-choice variables; open-loop Poisson 1.0 and 2.5 requests/s; fleets (2+2), (3+1), and homogeneous (4+0); burst calm .3/s with 60-s pulses at [120,180] and [300,360], peaks 4.0/s on (2+2) or 2.5/s on (3+1); 60-300 s SLO sweep, 180 s headline; lambda_l=.05/.1/.2 and pressure ladders {0,1.5,3} or {0,.5,1}; three arrival seeds for the headline burst. Exact checkpoints, engine/version, token lengths, KV limits, tool-delay distributions, and hysteresis thresholds not stated.
key_parameters.zh: 單節點四 GPU H200 fleet；DAG 最多 11 nodes、3 models x 8 verification policies、少於 270 個 joint-choice variables；open-loop Poisson 為 1.0 與 2.5 requests/s；fleet 為 (2+2)、(3+1) 與 homogeneous (4+0)；burst calm 為 .3/s，於 [120,180] 與 [300,360] 各有 60 秒 pulse，(2+2) peak 4.0/s、(3+1) peak 2.5/s；SLO sweep 60–300 s、headline 180 s；lambda_l=.05/.1/.2，pressure ladder 為 {0,1.5,3} 或 {0,.5,1}；headline burst 使用三個 arrival seeds。精確 checkpoint、engine/version、token 長度、KV 限制、工具延遲分布與 hysteresis threshold 未載明。

metrics_defined.en: Correctness uses each benchmark's official metric and counts timeout/incomplete as wrong; E2E is admission to final output including queues, models, verification, tools, and retry; SLO goodput is correct and within deadline.
metrics_defined.zh: Correctness 採各 benchmark 官方指標，timeout/incomplete 計為錯誤；E2E 自 admission 起至 final output，包含 queue、model、verification、tool 與 retry；SLO goodput 定義為正確且於 deadline 內完成。

headline_vs_realistic.en: Across four tasks, accuracy is 3-10 points above the highest-accuracy baseline at 1.1-6.8x lower latency; under the (3+1) stable guardrail, ladder goodput is 72.6% versus 62.9% for base and no plan shifts occur.
headline_vs_realistic.zh: 四項 task 的 accuracy 相較最高 accuracy baseline 提升 3–10 個百分點，latency 降低 1.1–6.8x；在 (3+1) stable guardrail 下，ladder goodput 為 72.6%、base 為 62.9%，且未發生 plan shift。

key_assumption_dynamic.en: Dyserve requires a finite materialized DAG with branches resolved and bounded loops unrolled at admission; later graph expansion must start a new compilation.
key_assumption_dynamic.zh: Dyserve 要求 admission 時已有 finite materialized DAG，且 branch 已解析、bounded loop 已展開；後續 graph expansion 必須另啟新 compilation。
